text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, entering the ring next—the pair everyone's been waiting for!
Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh, let's do thiiiiiis!!
Yo, Scarlet, you ready to eat my dust?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, the only thing I'm prepared for is making you cry!
Oh... hello, everyone! Thanks for coming to cheer us on today!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this tremendous roar from the crowd! Without a doubt, the greatest
spotlight today falls upon these two representatives of the modern horsegirl racing world!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
While they may not be in peak Twinkle Series condition,
they're sure to put on a spectacular performance for us all!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And yet! Stepping up to declare that she has no intention
of conceding victory is this up-and-coming contender—!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm Buena Vista. I've trained as hard as I could for today!
I'm ready to give it my all—please wish me luck!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO, BUENA VISTAAA~!!
YOU GOT THIIIIIIIS!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Such insane anticipation and hype for an un-debuted
racer! Just what kind of performance are we about to witness?!
choice_data_list: (The cheers... are truly deafening.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every time she flashes a smile from the paddock, the crowd erupts.
After taking in the overwhelming sight, I turn to her—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are...!
You said you wanted to talk before we hit the track... What's up?
choice_data_list: Yeah, listen—
Yeah, listen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I step right in front of her—just one pace closer than usual.
Looking straight into her eyes, I speak in a gentle, steady voice.
choice_data_list: Let's take a moment to focus before you go.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Focus...?
choice_data_list: Right. Just listen only to my voice for a second.
Right. Just listen only to my voice for a second.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume have remarkably sharp hearing. Even down here in the underground
tunnel, the roaring cheers from outside echo with crystal clarity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, their exceptional hearing has keen directional focus.
That is why I speak slowly and clearly.
choice_data_list: Breathe with me. Inhale... and exhale.
Breathe with me. Inhale... and exhale.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? I—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I just realized.
I guess I was way more nervous than I thought.
choice_data_list: You've always been... deeply attuned to the atmosphere.
You've always been... deeply attuned to the atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
! ...Hehe, yeah, that's true.
I guess I let all the crowd's energy get to my head.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
But I'm totally fine now! Thank you, Trainer. I'm heading out.
—I'm gonna go win this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And at last... the fateful Event Competition gets underway.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*... Hmph—!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet smoothly glides to the front right from the start!
What fantastic positioning! She's taking firm control of the pace!
choice_data_list: (You're okay, just maintain your own rhythm...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Stay calm, don't rush. Conserve your energy and turn this into
a final stretch battle—'Even against Daiwa Scarlet, you can take her!')

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Stay calm, don't rush. Conserve your energy and turn this into
a final stretch battle—'Even against Daiwa Scarlet, you can take her!')

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, let's do this! ORAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Vodka's explosive finishing burst is... terrifying!
But at the same time, her line can waver... Which means!!)
choice_data_list: There's an opening ahead! Go, Buenaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Daaaaahhhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet holds the lead! Vodka is hot on her heels!!
Wait, here comes Buena Vista! Buena Vista is surging forward too!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
200 meters to go! Will it be Vodka, Daiwa Scarlet, or Buena Vista?!
Buena Vista is closing in fast! The finish line is right ahead—!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(It hurts, ngh... but I can't give an inch! I want to win, I want to win!!
Right here... this is the one race I can't lose, ngh—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAHHH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Finishing in 3rd by just a nose against that fearsome pair...
She's absurd as always. ...Gotta admit, she sure knows how to entertain.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, she was already amazing before, but... didn't she level up big time?!
Could it be, could it beee~ thanks to that special someone of hers~?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Buena-san... Hehe, I see.
I just felt a sacred divine guidance.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even so, my story will not stop here.
Hehehehe...♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Phew....
—It's over, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I could only nod in silence. I had been far too naive, plain and simple.
Just as I was about to apologize, overwhelmed by frustration and guilt—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, I'm so frustrated.
I'm so, so frustrated...!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No matter what! Today, of all days... I really wanted to win.
And... I wanted to prove it to you.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's so frustrating, so frustrating! I wanted to show you!
That as long as you're here—that with you by my side, we can win!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I just... wanted you to see it...!
choice_data_list: Buena—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tears streamed down her face for quite a while.
Just like... when she was little. And then—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I told you before, didn't I?
When you asked me about the "magnificent view" I'm aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I said that I would reach that breathtaking view, no matter what.
And that I never once doubted it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Well, do you know why I was able to believe that without a single doubt?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Why I've always believed that I could run in a way that captivates everyone,
and makes everyone want to cheer for me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Because you've always, always been there for me!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because you've always been captivated by my running.
Because you've always cheered me on with all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even as we grew up, even when we were apart—
you were always, always in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...So, you see?
choice_data_list: Buena... you—
Buena... you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the realization struck deep within me.
It seemed... she had gotten ahead of me yet again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had already figured out the answer we needed to reach long before I did.
Feeling embarrassed that I was supposed to be the older one, I opened my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once more. As many times as it takes.
So that I can catch up to her running ahead, and support her back.
choice_data_list: Buena, let me say it properly this time. Will you—!
Buena, let me say it properly this time. Will you—!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Wait.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, gently.
...Her outstretched index finger lightly tapped my lips.
choice_data_list: Ah—?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. Can I be selfish just this once?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If we're starting over, I want to do it from the very beginning.
...Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—once again, we stood facing each other at our promised place.
choice_data_list: Sorry to keep you waiting, Buena. ...Will you—
Sorry to keep you waiting, Buena. ...Will you—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: Form a contract with me as my trainee?
Form a contract with me as my trainee?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Yes, gladly! My Trainer!
